formats.title: Client return body
formats.producedBy: Hand-built from the IRS scenario PDF
formats.description: What one client company files: its Filer block (EIN, name, name control, address), the tax period, and ReturnData with the form and any schedules. It carries no Pyramos values. ClientReturnBody.load parses it, locks returnVersion to 2026Q1v4.0, and checks that ReturnData opens with the main document for the returnTypeCd.

formats.title: Line mapping
formats.description: One row per value in the client body: which form line it comes from, the XML element path, the value, and the PDF page. It is the audit trail from the IRS scenario to the XML.

formats.title: Composed Return
formats.description: The full Return IRS receives. The composer wraps the client body in a ReturnHeader with OriginatorTypeCd ReportingAgent, a ReportingAgentPINGrp, and a ReportingAgent94XFilerGrp naming Pyramos. This snapshot uses schema-valid stand-in originator values (EFIN 000000, PIN 00000, agent EIN 000000000) and a fixed clock of 2026-10-13T14:00Z. A live send fills those from MEF_EFIN, MEF_RA_PIN, MEF_SOFTWARE_ID and the other MEF_RA_* settings.

formats.title: Manifest
formats.description: The IRS submission manifest that travels next to the Return in the submission archive: SubmissionId, EFIN, TaxYr, GovernmentCd, FederalSubmissionTypeCd, the tax period, and the client TIN. The snapshot uses the fixed submission id 0000002026286abc1234. A live send mints EFIN + yyyyDDD + 7 random characters.

legacy.title: Orchid 941, OneWell-era full Return
legacy.description: A complete Return with its own ReturnHeader, filed as OnlineFiler with an OnlineFilerPINGrp. This is the format the OneWell self-filer build sent. ClientReturnBody.load refuses a Return root, so this file cannot enter the Reporting Agent path. Form941XmlGenerationTest and the gated Form941SubmissionTest still read it.
